summary: No provision, incident or enforcement practice specific to Afyonkarahisar was identified in the sources: the omnibus 11th Judicial Package reported by Human Rights Watch on 29 October 2025 carries no Afyonkarahisar-specific provision, and the Kaos GL 2025 human-rights report records no Afyonkarahisar-specific finding. The province stands under Turkey's national framework, and the national assessment applies to visitors here.
tangentialFactors: The two sources bearing on Afyonkarahisar are country-wide instruments. The Human Rights Watch report analyses a leaked draft of the 11th Judicial Package, and the Kaos GL report aggregates violations across Turkey from media and civil-society accounts. Neither disaggregates its findings by province, so no comparison can be drawn between conditions in Afyonkarahisar and conditions in any other Turkish province, and neither source indicates that this province diverges from or exceeds the national pattern.
localsOnly: No provincial evidence was identified on the position of LGBTI+ residents in Afyonkarahisar, on detentions by provincial police, on local access to hormone replacement therapy or gender-affirming care, or on local employment, housing and schooling conditions. The conditions applying to residents of the province are those set out in the national record for Turkey.
outOfScopeNotes: Sub-national figures for detentions, prosecutions or violent incidents in Afyonkarahisar are not published in the sources. Whether the draft 11th Judicial Package has been enacted remains unresolved, and because the package carries no province-specific provision, its effect in Afyonkarahisar cannot be assessed separately from its national effect. Whether provincial police in Afyonkarahisar conduct identity checks or public-order policing differently from elsewhere in Turkey is not documented.
